newsitem.title: CHINA: China bars new red chips before congress -- paper.
newsitem.headline: China bars new red chips before congress -- paper.

text.p: Chinese securities regulators will block further listings by red-chip companies in Hong Kong until after China's 15th Communist Party Congress to be held later this year, the Hong Kong Economic Times said on Thursday.

The China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) has indicated that it has no intention to give approval for any red chip listings before the end of the congress, expected by late September or early October, the newspaper reported.

Red chips are Hong Kong-based companies with Chinese mainland financial backing. At least 14 municipal and provincial governments in China were preparing to seek listings for their window companies in Hong Kong, the paper said.

The Economic Times quoted unidentified sources as saying a new team of the top communist party leadership would be elected in the upcoming party congress and it was important to maintain stability and to avoid contradictions.
The Chinese government will also need time to work out details of a new set of guidelines for red chips, it said.

Under the guidelines, red chip listing plans have to be approved by CSRC and the Securities Commission of the State Council, the paper said. CSRC will manage red chip listings and the number of new listings will not increase rapidly, it said.
